title: CargaExpress
description: Android marketplace prototype delivered for a real-world client
longDescription: CargaExpress App is a simple Android application built with Java in Android Studio, using basic fields and activity flows. It was my first real-world client project and became a key milestone in applying classroom development skills to practical client requirements.

title: Grade Prediction System
description: Academic performance tracking system deployed on university servers
longDescription: A system developed for Pangasinan State University currently utilized in Computer Science Lab 3 and Lab 4. Focused on predictive analysis and academic performance tracking using machine learning principles.

title: ChainMarket
description: First hackathon blockchain marketplace project for buying and selling products
longDescription: ChainMarket was my first hackathon project using Base blockchain: an online marketplace for buying and selling a wide range of products, with blockchain used as an immutable identification database to prove product purchase.

title: PandanChain
longDescription: Contributed to the development and implementation of the PandanChain system during its active development phase. Worked on system architecture, smart contracts, and integration with blockchain infrastructure.

title: Sillag
description: Blockchain-based system with team leadership responsibilities
longDescription: Assigned as developer for the Sillag blockchain system and promoted to Team Lead after internal restructuring. Handled coordination, task distribution, and feature implementation while maintaining code quality and team productivity.

title: PromptGraph
description: Live web crawler and LLM-based tracking system
longDescription: Served as Pull Request Reviewer and QA contributor for PromptGraph, a production web crawler system. Reviewed production-level code for quality and security issues while performing ticket-based development tasks.
